# Ornate Interior Decor

Ornate Interior Decor is an interior design and turnkey execution studio based in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## Studio Details

- Address: 148/E, 17th Main Rd, SBI Staff Colony, Hosahalli Extension, Stage 1, Vijayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560040, India
- Email: ornateinteriord@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 98450 44424
- Office Hours: Monday to Friday 09:00 - 18:00, Saturday 10:00 - 16:00

## Core Services

- Residential interior design (apartments, villas, living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms)
- Commercial interior design (offices, retail, hospitality spaces)
- Architectural space planning and layout optimization
- Custom furniture and millwork detailing
- Color and material curation
- End-to-end site coordination and project management
